summary: K Wave Media Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing the planned retirement of 9,827,057 ordinary shares, representing approximately 13% of outstanding shares. The shares are to be returned under a Rescission and Termination Agreement dated May 29, 2026, which rescinds an earlier equity purchase agreement for Solaire Partners. The shares will be transferred to the Company within 60 days and then retired and cancelled. Management views this as streamlining the corporate structure. No price per share or premium is applicable as this is a share cancellation, not a buyback. The expected close is by end of July 2026. Watch for completion of the return and any associated regulatory filings.
